summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Picture a traveler who needs a roomy, smart suitcase that can charge devices on the go. The Away Bigger Carry‑On with Pocket offers a removable battery, plenty of room and a built‑in charger, making it ideal for frequent flyers and tech‑savvy travelers. Its main catch is that it is heavier than some other carry‑ons.
